messages:
Lena (HW Partnerships): Heads-up: TerraCore asked for a joint perf/W benchmark for marketplace listing. Need a minimal, reproducible protocol they can run in their lab.
Marco (Perf Eng): We should keep it simple: power meter model, 10-min steady windows, and exact driver/toolchain pins.
Anika (ML Applied): Model: llama2-7b q4. Provide tokenization script + seed. Use 300 sample prompts.
Jordan (Solutions): Legal wants raw logs and a 5-business-day review before announcement. Also a partner quote template.
bench-bot: created folder https://redwood.example/s/terracore-bench and ticket #P-4501.
Marco (Perf Eng): I'll draft run script `run_terracore.sh` that sets governor, does warmup prefixes, and emits JSONL telemetry.
Anika (ML Applied): Include batch shapes [1,16,64] and warmup=8x64 tokens. Capture output hashes.
Lena (HW Partnerships): Timeline idea: Tue handoff, Wed run, Thu verify, Fri sign-off. Add buffer day for kernel retune.
Jordan (Solutions): I'll prepare gating checklist and partner legal template.
Marco (Perf Eng): Agree. Action: Marco -> script + verifier; Anika -> prompts + verifier checks; Jordan -> gating doc; bench-bot -> add runbook template.
Lena (HW Partnerships): Thanks all. I'll schedule a 20-min sync with TerraCore PM for Tuesday.
